parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: ____ to the hotel manager, the local bars can get crowded after 9 p.m.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: The cowboys haven’t found all the cattle, but they’re making a lot of progresses and have caught more than half of them already.
It normally takes me twenty-five minutes to clean the car, but now, with my injured arm, I have to spend over a hour doing it, and I can’t even do it well.
Come down, Mary. You know that’s not true.
Write the address carefully and don’t let out the postcode.
We quarrelled what had gone wrong for a very long time.
I love my mother-by-law. She’s a wonderful human being.
With regards travel and accommodation, the company will pay for everything.
I’m driving there, so just stay where you are and I’ll come and lift you on the way.
My work as a police officer involves me to go into dangerous situations that people would normally advise you to avoid.
I wish I had put up boxing years ago. It’s a great way to stay fit.

parts.text: A stream is a small river. By unsettled weather, we mean weather that’s constantly changing. Spiders don’t make honey; bees do! The referee blew his whistle to stop the game. The plural of “deer” is “deer”. We call the word “the” the definite article. Humans have four limbs. We use an axe to split wood. Let me know if you come across my sunglasses anywhere. Don’t look at my phone. Mind your own business! You needn’t have cut all the vegetables. Carla’s got a rather odd sense of humour, hasn’t she?

teacher.2: What artificial parts of the body can science provide us with?

I’m driving there, so just stay where you are and I’ll come and pick you up on the way.
